description: This script ensures the presence of a root-level 'gradlew' wrapper script in a project, creating one if it does not exist. The generated script delegates to an Android-specific 'gradlew' if available, or otherwise skips the Gradle build step.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main execution logic of the ensure-gradlew.sh script, which checks for the existence of 'gradlew' and creates it if missing.
